text: Framework-agnostic TypeScript authentication and authorization library installed from npm
quote: Better Auth is a framework-agnostic, universal authentication and authorization framework for TypeScript.

text: Works with your own database, including SQLite, PostgreSQL, MySQL and others
quote: Better Auth requires a database to store user data. You can easily configure Better Auth to use SQLite, PostgreSQL, or MySQL, and more!

text: Automatic database management, with migrations or schema generation for the required tables
quote: Run the migration or generate the schema to add the necessary fields and tables to the database.

text: Built-in email and password authentication with sessions, email verification and password reset
quote: Built-in credential auth. Sessions, email verification, and password reset included.

text: Client SDK method for email sign-up, with optional callback URL, name and image
quote: const { data, error } = await authClient.signUp.email({ email, password, name, image, callbackURL: "/dashboard" }

text: Users are signed in automatically after sign-up, and this can be turned off with autoSignIn
quote: By default, the users are automatically signed in after they successfully sign up. To disable this behavior you can set `autoSignIn` to `false`.

text: Passwords are hashed with scrypt by default
quote: Better Auth uses the `scrypt` algorithm to hash passwords by default.

text: The password hashing function can be customized in configuration
quote: You can customize the password hashing function by setting the `password` option in the configuration.

text: Sign-in with multiple social providers such as Google, GitHub, Apple and Discord
quote: Better Auth supports multiple social providers, including Google, GitHub, Apple, Discord, and more.

text: Two-factor authentication using TOTP authenticator apps or email/SMS OTP codes
quote: totp (default) sets up an authenticator app... otp enables email/SMS-based codes immediately

text: 2FA backup codes for account recovery, plus enabling or disabling 2FA
quote:
Additional features include:

* Generating backup codes for account recovery
* Enabling/disabling 2FA
* Managing trusted devices

text: Management of trusted devices for two-factor authentication
quote: Enabling/disabling 2FA * Managing trusted devices

text: Plugins for passkeys, magic links, email OTP and username login
quote: can easily be extended using plugins, such as: username, magic link, passkey, email-otp, and more.

text: JWT plugin with endpoints to fetch a JWT and a JWKS endpoint to verify it
quote: The JWT plugin provides endpoints to retrieve a JWT token and a JWKS endpoint to verify the token.

text: Configurable session expiry, with sliding renewal through updateAge (7-day default)
quote: The session expires after 7 days by default. But whenever the session is used and the updateAge is reached, the session expiration is updated

text: Session refresh mode where GET is read-only and the client automatically POSTs to refresh
quote: When enabled, GET becomes read-only and returns `needsRefresh: true` when refresh is needed. The client automatically calls POST to perform the refresh.

text: Users can revoke their own sessions to log out of other devices or browsers
quote: A logged in user can also revoke their own sessions to log out from different devices or browsers.

text: Built-in rate limiter with a configurable time window and maximum request count
quote: Better Auth includes a built-in rate limiter to help manage traffic and prevent abuse.

text: Stricter default rate-limit rules on sensitive paths, such as 3 email sign-in requests per 10 seconds
quote:
Better Auth provides custom rules for specific paths. For example:

* `/sign-in/email`: Is limited to 3 requests within 10 seconds.

text: Configurable client IP header for rate limiting behind proxies
quote: If you are using a different header to track the user's IP address, you'll need to specify it.

text: Security features including bot detection, IP blocking and email validation
quote: Security & observability. Bot detection, IP blocking, and email validation.

text: Non-destructive rotation of BETTER_AUTH_SECRET with lazy re-encryption, no migration or downtime
quote: Ordinary key rotation requires no database migration or downtime. Data is lazily re-encrypted with the current key when it is next written.

text: MCP plugin makes your app an OAuth authorization server and protected resource for MCP clients
quote: The **MCP** plugin lets your app act as an OAuth authorization server and protected resource for [Model Context Protocol](https://modelcontextprotocol.io) clients.

text: Auth for AI agents, including MCP auth, token exchange and agent delegation
quote: Auth for AI agents. MCP auth, token exchange, and agent delegation.

text: Hosted remote MCP server offering docs search, examples and setup help to MCP clients like Cursor and Claude Code
quote: Better Auth hosts a **remote MCP server** that exposes documentation search, examples, and setup help to any MCP-capable client (Cursor, Codex, Claude Code, Open Code, and others).

text: Organization plugin for managing organization members and teams
quote: The organization plugin allows you to manage your organization's members and teams. Organizations simplifies user access and permissions management.

text: Built-in multi-tenancy with teams, roles, invitations and access control
quote: Multi-tenancy built in. Teams, roles, invitations, and access control.

text: Assign roles and permissions within organizations
quote: Organizations simplifies user access and permissions management. Assign roles and permissions to streamline project management, team coordination, and partnerships.

text: SSO plugin supporting OpenID Connect, OAuth2 providers and SAML 2.0
quote: Single Sign-On (SSO) allows users to authenticate with multiple applications using a single set of credentials. This plugin supports OpenID Connect (OIDC), OAuth2 providers, and SAML 2.0.

text: Enterprise SCIM provisioning and directory sync
quote:
Enterprise ready.

SSO, SAML 2.0, SCIM, and directory sync.

text: Admin plugin to create users, manage roles, ban or unban users, and impersonate users
quote: It allows administrators to perform various operations such as creating users, managing user roles, banning/unbanning users, impersonating users, and more.

text: API Key plugin to create, manage and verify API keys that authenticate API requests
quote: The API Key plugin allows you to create and manage API keys for your application. It provides a way to authenticate and authorize API requests by verifying API keys.

text: API keys with built-in rate limiting, custom expiration, remaining-use counts and refill
quote: Create, manage, and verify API keys * Built-in rate limiting * Custom expiration times, remaining count, and refill systems

text: API keys can be owned by organizations as well as by users
quote: Organization-owned API keys in addition to user-owned keys

text: OAuth 2.0 Device Authorization Grant (RFC 8628) for CLIs, smart TVs, IoT devices and consoles
quote: The Device Authorization plugin implements the code issuance and approval flow from the OAuth 2.0 Device Authorization Grant ([RFC 8628](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc8628)) for limited-input devices such as smart TVs, CLI applic

text: Official CLI, including npx auth init for project setup
quote: `npx auth init`

text: The device authorization flow can be tested using the Better Auth CLI
quote: You can test the device authorization flow right now using the Better Auth CLI

text: Server-side auth.api methods for authenticating users on the server
quote: To authenticate a user on the server, you can use the auth.api methods.

text: Integrations with Next.js, Nuxt, SvelteKit, Astro, Hono and 20+ more frameworks
quote: Next.js, Nuxt, SvelteKit, Astro, Hono, and 20+ more.

text: Auth configuration defined in code, so it is version-controlled, type-safe and reviewable in PRs
quote: No dashboard clicks. Your auth lives in code version controlled, type-safe, and reviewable in PRs.

text: Ecosystem of 50+ plugins, including passkeys, magic links, API keys and JWTs
quote:
50+ and growing.

Passkeys, magic links, API keys, JWTs, and more.

text: Auth0 migration guide covering hashed passwords, social accounts and two-factor authentication
quote: migrate a project from Auth0 to Better Auth — including email/password with proper hashing, social/external accounts, two-factor authentication, and more.

text: Auth0 migration script attempts best-effort transfer of organizations, members and per-member roles
quote: the script will also attempt a best-effort migration of Auth0 Organizations, their members, and per-member roles.
